Create a SonarQube Generic XML file

Source: R/sonarqube.R
sonarqube.Rd

Write coverage in the generic test data XML format read by SonarQube.

Usage

sonarqube(x, file = "sonarqube.xml", path_prefix = NULL)

Arguments

x

the coverage object returned from package_coverage()

file

the name of the SonarQube Generic XML file

path_prefix

SonarQube expects file paths relative to the project's base directory. By default the paths are relative to the package root (e.g. R/foo.R), which is correct when the package is the root of the SonarQube project. If the package is in a subdirectory of the project, set path_prefix to that subdirectory (e.g. "pkg" gives pkg/R/foo.R).

Value

The XML document (an xml2 document), invisibly, after writing it to file.

Details

Every line with coverage is reported as a lineToCover with its lineNumber and whether it is covered, including the lines of compiled code. Each line is reported once: when several functions share a line, it is only covered if all its code was run, as in report() and percent_coverage().

Branches are only reported if they were measured with options(covr.branch_coverage = TRUE) (see covr.branch_coverage). A line where an if or switch() starts then also has branchesToCover, the number of branches of the if and switch() calls on the line, and coveredBranches, how many of them were taken.

This functionality requires the xml2 package be installed.
